kjv: [seeing] she hath wrought lewdness with many, and the holy flesh is passed from thee
mine: when she has done many vile deeds? Can vows and sacred flesh avert your doom?
note: MT is very difficult (hamzimmatah harabbim); I follow the LXX's "vows" (nedarim for harabbim) and read ya'aviru "avert"; the KJV renders the MT literally.
Hebrew kekebes 'alluf is "like a tame/docile lamb" ('alluf "tame, familiar"); the KJV took 'alluf as "ox" and supplied "or".
